description: Engine setup of map6_s03 (Sewer to Lakeside Amusement Park), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type DRU, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Stalker, GreyChild, Mumbler and HangedScratcher). A mod changes it with its own maps/map6_s03/overlay.json.
